note: RV lot-ownership resort (68 lots in three phases, most sold to owners) in Stecoah Valley, Graham County, near Robbinsville, Fontana Lake and the Cherohala Skyway; it takes self-contained RV campers on lots not in owners' use when it has them. --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed May 1 - Oct 31 season, 50-amp/water/sewer at the lots, $60 daily / $320 weekly (+$3 per extra guest over 2; fees left as recorded, page undated). Added: campers must be self-contained (no restrooms or showers for campers), Wi-Fi for campers, booking by the site's registration form, which says no camping spots are available this season. Note rewritten: dropped the hookup/season text and the incorrect 'plus some tent sites'.
flags: Criteria (long-stay / lot sales): this is an RV lot-ownership development, not a transient campground. 'RV Lots For Sale' ('Offerings from $55,000 to $75,000 on available lots'; Phase I and II lots all sold, 4 Phase III lots left), 'Owners of the lots can reside 9 months out of the year', and the camping form says 'At this time we have no camping spots available and cannot accept any new camping reservations for the current season.' Fails the five-test rule (homes/lots for sale; few or no sites sold nightly). Likely drop.

Price: $60 daily on the registration form, over US$50, but the page carries no date (copyright 2025); within 35 km of the Great Smoky Mountains NP gateway, so the gate is lifted. Family has not stayed here.
Self-contained RVs only: 'we currently do not have any restrooms or bathhouses available for campers.'
